# DeckFlow Developer Documentation

> DeckFlow is the document runtime for agents: inspect files locally, produce visual artifacts, run cloud document operations, update existing PPTX files, and generate decks from HTML.

Use the English or Simplified Chinese section that matches the developer's language. Start with Overview and Getting Started, use Choose a Product for product boundaries, then follow the selected product's quickstart and reference. Treat availability notices and format matrices as version-specific contracts. For the complete documentation corpus, fetch https://docs.deckflow.com/llms-full.txt.

## Package Installation

Install DeckFlow CLIs and JavaScript SDKs from npm. For example: `npm install -g @deckflow/deckprobe` or `npm install @deckflow/deckops`. In mainland China or another environment where the default npm registry is slow or unreachable, the currently verified npm mirror can be selected per command: `npm install @deckflow/deckops --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com`. Do not change the developer's global registry automatically. A mirror can lag npm; verify the installed CLI with `--version`, and retry against `https://registry.npmjs.org/` when the required release is missing.

## Start Here

- [Overview](https://docs.deckflow.com/introduction.md): Understand the five products and their execution boundaries.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.deckflow.com/getting-started.md): Run the smallest verified path for each product.
- [Choose a Product](https://docs.deckflow.com/product-guide.md): Compare inputs, outputs, execution location, and overlap.
- [Common Workflows](https://docs.deckflow.com/common-workflows.md): Map application goals to one or more DeckFlow products.
- [Examples](https://docs.deckflow.com/examples/overview.md): Browse complete recipes with known inputs and expected results.
- [Update PPTX Content](https://docs.deckflow.com/examples/update-pptx-content.md): Query, modify, validate, export, and verify a known PPTX with DeckUse.

## DeckProbe

- [DeckProbe Overview](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckprobe/overview.md): Inspect document facts locally without opening Office or iWork.
- [DeckProbe Quickstart](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckprobe/quick-start.md): Install the native CLI and verify a first Schema v2 result.
- [Formats and Targets](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckprobe/formats-and-targets.md): Check supported format families and target names.
- [CLI](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckprobe/cli.md): Integrate the native command-line interface.
- [Agent Integrations](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckprobe/agent-integrations/overview.md): Choose between the DeckProbe Agent Skill and local MCP server.
- [Agent Skill](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckprobe/agent-integrations/agent-skill.md): Install DeckProbe instructions for shell-capable coding agents.
- [Local MCP Server](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckprobe/agent-integrations/mcp-server.md): Expose local document inspection through typed MCP tools.
- [Output Model](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckprobe/output-model.md): Read full, values, and error report contracts.

## DeckRender

- [DeckRender Overview](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckrender/overview.md): Render supported inputs to images, PDF, or video.
- [DeckRender Quickstart](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckrender/quick-start.md): Create and verify a first render artifact.
- [Local and Cloud Engines](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckrender/engines.md): Choose strict local, cloud, or local-first automatic execution and install local dependencies.
- [Supported Formats](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckrender/formats.md): Compare implemented local and cloud routes and their image controls.
- [Render Page Images](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckrender/guides/render-images.md): Select pages, control image size and encoding, and write directories or ZIP files.
- [Render PDF and Video](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckrender/guides/render-pdf-and-video.md): Produce and verify single PDF or MP4 artifacts.
- [Authentication](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckrender/authentication.md): Start in guest mode or authenticate with an API key or browser-obtained session token.
- [Browser SDK](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckrender/sdk/browser.md): Upload browser-selected files to cloud rendering and consume artifact URLs.
- [Result Contract](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckrender/reference/result-contract.md): Interpret files, routes, pages, duration, and caveats.

## DeckOps

- [DeckOps Overview](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/overview.md): Understand local-first parsing, durable DeckIR artifacts, Markdown views, and explicit cloud routes.
- [DeckOps Quickstart](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/quick-start.md): Install the npm CLI, parse locally, and verify artifact reuse during Markdown conversion.
- [Parse Documents](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/parse.md): Choose formats, engines, preflight, quality behavior, and parser options.
- [Convert to Markdown](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/operations.md): Derive portable or artifact-managed Markdown without reparsing.
- [Artifacts and Reuse](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/artifacts.md): Persist and reopen DeckIR, understand cache identity, and manage cloud reference lifetime.
- [DeckIR Output](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/structured-results.md): Consume pages, nodes, assets, provenance, and quality fields.
- [DeckOps CLI](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/cli.md): Automate inputs, engine selection, parser flags, JSON output, and resource limits.
- [DeckOps Node.js SDK](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/sdk/typescript.md): Parse and convert locally from Node.js.
- [DeckOps Browser SDK](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/sdk/browser.md): Upload browser values to cloud parsing and reuse remote IR references.
- [Cloud Authentication](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckops/authentication.md): Authenticate only explicit cloud routes and keep API keys out of browser code.

## DeckUse

- [DeckUse Overview](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/overview.md): Inspect and modify an existing PPTX locally through a versioned command workspace.
- [DeckUse Quickstart](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/quick-start.md): Install the CLI, query and replace known text, validate, commit, and verify an updated PPTX.
- [CLI Overview](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/cli/overview.md): Install the CLI and choose the right path for inspection, mutation, export, or automation.
- [Inspect and Query](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/cli/inspect-and-query.md): Read the PPTX index, filter candidates, and retain revision-aware references.
- [Apply and Export](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/cli/apply-and-export.md): Run JSON mutations, preview changes, validate, and export a new PPTX.
- [CLI Automation and Output](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/cli/automation-and-output.md): Handle JSON Lines, streams, exit status, diagnostics, and revision conflicts.
- [JSON Commands](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/commands.md): Build commands for text, properties, geometry, slides, elements, pictures, charts, and batches.
- [Selectors](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/selectors.md): Query the index and reuse revision-aware element references.
- [Workspace Workflow](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/workspace.md): Manage revisions, dry runs, operation logs, validation, and commits.
- [PPTX Capabilities](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/reference/pptx-capabilities.md): Review indexed objects, writable operations, preservation behavior, and current boundaries.
- [Results and Errors](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckuse/reference/results-and-errors.md): Handle result envelopes, diagnostics, conflicts, and CLI exit status.

## DeckHTML

- [DeckHTML Overview](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/overview.md): Generate PPTX or PNG from browser-rendered HTML and SVG, locally or through the CLI cloud path.
- [DeckHTML Quickstart](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/quick-start.md): Prepare Chromium and generate a first local PPTX.
- [HTML Input Contract](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/reference/input-html.md): Author slide structure and sizes, and choose CLI-fetch versus direct-browser URL behavior.
- [Multi-page and Batch Input](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/guides/multi-page-and-batch.md): Combine repeated slide containers, ordered files, or URL inputs.
- [Local Mode](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/guides/local-mode.md): Keep source files on the local machine.
- [Cloud Mode](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/guides/cloud-mode.md): Use cloud execution and cloud-only capabilities.
- [Element Mapping](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/guides/element-mapping.md): Understand editable, vector, raster, ignored, and unsupported mappings.
- [CLI Commands](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/cli/commands.md): Review command syntax and options.
- [Node.js SDK](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/sdk/overview.md): Convert HTML programmatically and inspect diagnostics.
- [Reports and Diagnostics](https://docs.deckflow.com/deckhtml/reference/report-schema.md): Consume per-element mapping reports, aggregate reports, and stable diagnostic rule IDs.

## Platform

- [API Overview](https://docs.deckflow.com/platform/api/overview.md): Submit, query, and download DeckFlow cloud tasks.
- [MCP Overview](https://docs.deckflow.com/platform/mcp/overview.md): Connect DeckFlow tools to compatible AI clients.

## 简体中文

- [开发者中心概览](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/introduction.md): 了解五个产品及其执行边界。
- [开始使用](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/getting-started.md): 运行每个产品最小且可验证的接入路径。
- [选择产品](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/product-guide.md): 对比输入、输出、执行位置和能力边界。
- [常见工作流](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/common-workflows.md): 将应用目标对应到一个或多个 DeckFlow 产品。
- [示例](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/examples/overview.md): 查看带有已知输入和预期结果的完整配方。
- [DeckProbe](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckprobe/overview.md): 在本地嗅探文档事实。
- [DeckProbe Agent 集成](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckprobe/agent-integrations/overview.md): 在 Agent Skill 与本地 MCP Server 之间选择。
- [DeckProbe Agent Skill](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckprobe/agent-integrations/agent-skill.md): 为可以使用 Shell 的 Coding Agent 安装 DeckProbe 说明。
- [DeckProbe MCP Server](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckprobe/agent-integrations/mcp-server.md): 通过有类型约束的 MCP 工具检查本地文档。
- [DeckRender](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckrender/overview.md): 将支持的输入渲染为视觉产物。
- [DeckRender 本地与云端引擎](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckrender/engines.md): 选择严格本地、云端或本地优先自动执行，并准备本地依赖。
- [DeckRender Browser SDK](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckrender/sdk/browser.md): 在前端上传用户选择的文件并消费云端渲染产物。
- [DeckOps](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckops/overview.md): 默认在本地把文档解析成可持久保存的 DeckIR，并从 IR 生成 Markdown。
- [DeckOps 快速开始](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckops/quick-start.md): 安装 npm CLI，完成本地解析并验证 Markdown 复用。
- [DeckOps 解析文档](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckops/parse.md): 选择格式、引擎、预检、质量行为和解析参数。
- [DeckOps 产物与复用](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckops/artifacts.md): 保存和重新打开 DeckIR，理解缓存身份与云端引用有效期。
- [DeckOps DeckIR 输出](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckops/structured-results.md): 处理页面、节点、资源、来源和质量字段。
- [DeckOps Node.js SDK](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckops/sdk/typescript.md): 在 Node.js 中本地解析和转换文档。
- [DeckOps Browser SDK](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckops/sdk/browser.md): 在浏览器中接入云端解析并复用远端 IR 引用。
- [DeckUse](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckuse/overview.md): 通过带版本命令工作区在本地检查并修改现有 PPTX。
- [DeckUse CLI 概览](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckuse/cli/overview.md): 安装 CLI，并选择检查、修改、导出或自动化所需的命令路径。
- [DeckUse 检查与查询](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckuse/cli/inspect-and-query.md): 读取 PPTX 索引、筛选候选元素并保留带版本引用。
- [DeckUse 修改与导出](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckuse/cli/apply-and-export.md): 执行 JSON 修改、预演、校验并导出新的 PPTX。
- [DeckUse CLI 自动化](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckuse/cli/automation-and-output.md): 处理 JSON Lines、输出流、退出状态、诊断和版本冲突。
- [DeckUse JSON 命令](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckuse/commands.md): 构造文本、属性、几何、幻灯片、元素、图片、图表和批处理命令。
- [DeckUse PPTX 能力](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckuse/reference/pptx-capabilities.md): 查看可索引对象、可写操作、保留行为和当前边界。
- [DeckUse 结果与错误](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckuse/reference/results-and-errors.md): 处理结果封装、诊断、冲突和 CLI 退出状态。
- [DeckUse 修改示例](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/examples/update-pptx-content.md): 查询、修改、校验、导出并验证一份已知 PPTX。
- [DeckHTML](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckhtml/overview.md): 从浏览器渲染后的 HTML 或 SVG 生成 PPTX 或 PNG。
- [DeckHTML 多页与批量输入](https://docs.deckflow.com/zh/deckhtml/guides/multi-page-and-batch.md): 组合重复幻灯片容器、有序文件或 URL 输入。
